children: Bengaluru: India's employment market is set for stronger hiring momentum in the second half of FY27, with employers projecting a 5.4% increase in workforce, up from 4.7% in the preceding six months and 4.4% in the corresponding period last year, according to the latest Employment Outlook Report from staffing firm TeamLease Services.

The report, based on insights from over 1,239 employers across 23 industries and 20 cities, found 60% employers plan to add headcount in the second half of FY27, 24% expect no change and 16% anticipate rationalisation. About 22% expect workforce growth of over 10%. The 5.4% net employment change is the highest recorded by TeamLease in the past 4.5 year periods.-Our Bureau

title: Workforce Likely to Grow 5.4% in H2 FY27: TeamLease
